title: a successor cannot stage a value of another specialization
purpose: Exercise a fragile combination of features identified by research or improvement findings.

failure.justification: The specialization mismatch is statically visible but may also be caught at the successor's parameter boundary.

provenance.origin: authored for OCS 0.1.0 from the cited contract text
